title: State under symbol lifting
statement: Let $e: ool	o	ext{Γ}$ be an injective map, let $x$ be a finite Boolean string, and let $c$ be a configuration on $x$. The state of the configuration obtained by lifting $c$ through $e$ equals the state of $c$.
